detail.longDescription:
I'm trying to use onclick and querySelector to do the following: there's four buttons->each button is connected to two, overlapping images(i plan to put more images in between them, so they have to be separated)->the two default images change at the same time to two other images when a button is clicked---no hide/show toggle. I've tried many combinations. Is it possible to do this with these commands? Or should i do something else? HTML:

Javascript: function changeImg(pngs) { let img = document.querySelectorAll("#imgSet1, #imgSet2"); img.setAttribute("src", pngs); }
